subject: Genetics
title: The $100 Genome
description: A quick win: understand The $100 Genome.

hook.text: In 2022, Illumina announced the $200 genome. Competitors pushed toward $100. The floor keeps dropping.

buildup.text: At $100, sequencing becomes cheaper than most blood tests. Routine genome screening becomes economically possible.

discovery.text: Cheap sequencing shifts the bottleneck from generating data to interpreting it. We produce more data than we understand.

twist.text: Storage is the hidden cost. One genome is 200 gigabytes raw. A million genomes need a data center. Cheap isn't free.

climax.text: The goal post keeps moving. Next-gen tools like nanopore promise sequencing on a phone-sized device. Anywhere, anytime.

punchline.text: The genome gets cheaper. Understanding it doesn't.

quiz.question: What is the new bottleneck after cheap sequencing?
